NBA DFS Picks for Monday, October 26 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Monday, October 26 · 7 games · First game 7:00 PM ET · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 26, 4:30 PM ET

Giannis Antetokounmpo (MIA) is the top-projected player on the Monday, October 26 DraftKings main slate at 58.1 DraftKings points for $9,900. Jayson Tatum (BOS, 53.1, $9,500) and Shai Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC, 48.9, $9,800) are next.

Jaylin Williams (OKC) returns the most per dollar among players projected for at least 20 points: 7.39 projected points per $1,000 at $3,600.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 26, 4:30 PM ET run of the Splash Play NBA model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are run, and NBA projections move with every injury report, so check the time above before you build.

How to use these numbers

A projection is a starting point. Salary decides who fits: the Pts/$1K column shows what each player returns for his price. A late scratch changes the minutes and shots of everyone around him, so the numbers from an earlier run can be out of date by the first game.
